name: Baseline Spectrum (Rust)
note: For `make sim-baseline` ONLY. See sim_baseline_green.json. Covers the same four locomotion x mount combinations from the other side with different weapons, so a change to one faction's hull or gun registers whichever colour it spawns as: wheels+turret (law_tank, ifv), wheels+fixed (gang_scout), hover+turret (syn_scout), tracks+turret (tank). Cost 890 of a 1000 budget.
